name: Rizuhble's Abracadabolt Sinclair
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Temporary: sell it later, once you're out of slots.
items.legacy_note: Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-9,600 (levels 1-16). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Vexing Bolt T3. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Duration Extender, vitality 4.8k at Veil Walker. Ultimate (Audience Participation) is available from Duration Extender.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 18.6 to Vexing Bolt's max damage (1.86x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling.

items.name: Extra Charge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Vexing Bolt (1 to 2).

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Vexing Bolt (179) clears its 80-damage trigger; Spectral Assistant stays under it.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 33.5 to Vexing Bolt's max damage (1.86x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Rabbit Hex: its duration-scaled parts (hex duration 2s) get +22%.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Veil Walker, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Veil Walker, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)
items.legacy_note: Bolt fights in other lanes from range to pick up assists.

items.name: Veil Walker
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 9,600-28,800 (levels 16-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Audience Participation T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Vexing Bolt, max damage) grows from 398 to 556.

items.name: Rapid Recharge
items.caption: Adds 1 more charge to Vexing Bolt (2 to 3). Takes spirit from 4,800 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. Upgrade of Extra Charge (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,000 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power. | Imbued on Rabbit Hex: widens its range.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Audience Participation copied ult window (9s), Spectral Assistant duration (13s), Vexing Bolt debuff duration (5s). Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Vexing Bolt (454) clears its 165-damage trigger; Spectral Assistant stays under it. Takes spirit from 9,600 to 12,000 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Spectral Assistant leash radius (25m), Rabbit Hex radius (6m), Vexing Bolt radius (3.2m). Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Vexing Bolt: takes 18% off its 11s base cooldown. Takes spirit from 14,400 to 16,000 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Audience Participation gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (85s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 28,800-48,000 (levels 29-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rabbit Hex T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Vexing Bolt, max damage) grows from 556 to 717.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.caption: +30 spirit adds about 55.8 to Vexing Bolt's max damage (1.86x scaling), your steepest spirit scaling. Upgrade of Improved Spirit (already owned): costs 4,800 souls more, not 6,400.

items.name: Vortex Web
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Pull them together, Rabbit Hex the lot, then bolt them.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 27,200 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 142s; 20% off is 28.4s per full rotation.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Veil Walker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.
sections.desc: Dying after Veil Walker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes keep landing on you.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: They dive you and you can't get back to range.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)
items.legacy_note: On the bolt. Sell Trophy Collector for this.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Rabbit Hex: resets its 16s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Replaces Tankbuster: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).
items.legacy_note: On Rabbit Hex. Sell Tankbuster for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
